Sam (Marketing Ops): Noticed a morning spike where ~30 leads dropped into the fallback owner. HubSpot shows enrichment pending so RR skipped. This hit MQL SLA.

Priya (Sales Ops): Any correlation with form type or source? Reps getting alert fatigue.

Ben (Analytics): Quick slice: 70% from event signups (long payloads), 20% from partner API, 10% misc. Median enrichment latency 9.3s during spike window. Claim window currently 4s.

Carlos (Platform): Two low-risk options: increase claim window to 10s OR perform immediate soft-assign to a transient owner and mark leads so reps can ignore until final assign.

Priya (Sales Ops): Soft-assign seems better so reps still see leads in their queue but we can suppress outreach. Need a clear flag to filter in SFDC.

Sam (Marketing Ops): Agree. Proposed behavior: optimistic soft-assign to `Holding - Awaiting Enrich` and set property `enrich_pending=true`. If enrichment completes and RR picks a rep, auto-reassign and append note "Reassigned after enrichment".

Carlos (Platform): Config snippet:
```
CLAIM_WINDOW_MS=4000
ENABLE_SOFT_ASSIGN=true
SOFT_OWNER=Holding-AwaitEnrich
ENRICH_FLAG_KEY=enrich_pending
SOFT_ASSIGN_TTL=1800
```
Soft assign TTL 30min to avoid permanent holds.

Ben (Analytics): Add metric tags: `lead.soft_assigned`, `lead.reassigned_after_enrich`. We'll monitor reassign_rate and duplicate-notify-rate. Target: <5% duplicate notifications.

Priya (Sales Ops): For SFDC: route `Holding-AwaitEnrich` to a queue that's excluded from active lists and suppress task creation until final assignment. I'll draft the assignment rule.

assign-bot: deploy queued: lead-router -> canary (build #1203).

Carlos (Platform): Canary plan: 500 synthetic leads, 30% with large enrichment payloads. Measure: percent soft-assigned, reassign success rate, avg time to final owner, duplicate-notify count. Will run at 3:30pm PT.

Sam (Marketing Ops): Rollout plan: canary 3:30pm, review results at 4:30pm, prod push 8:00pm if metrics within thresholds. Rollback: disable ENABLE_SOFT_ASSIGN and clear enrich_pending via batch job. Carlos will own rollback.

Priya (Sales Ops): I'll notify SDR leads about temporary queue and suppression rules. Make sure the one-pager tells them not to reach out while `enrich_pending=true`.

Ben (Analytics): I'll prepare Grafana dashboard panels and a short runbook to validate the canary. Post links here after run.

Carlos (Platform): On it. Will post canary ids and dashboard links in 60-90m. Ping me if you see >10% soft-assigned.

Sam (Marketing Ops): Thanks team. Let's get this in tonight; morning spikes are hurting our SDR SLA numbers. :rocket:
